feats.name: Aerial Expert
feats.description:
Origin feat · Prerequisite: Glide trait
You're adept at gliding:
• You no longer need to move at least 10 feet to make Long and High Jumps. You may use Strength or Dexterity to determine the height or distance, and you double the distance you'd normally leap.
• You may take the Dash action while gliding to fly an additional distance up to your Movement Speed.
• You may change direction freely while gliding, and may gain up to 10 feet of altitude once before finishing your descent.

feats.name: Bandit Cunning
feats.description:
Origin feat
Your time as a bandit sharpened your danger sense:
• When you must make a saving throw, you may use your Reaction to add your Intelligence modifier to it. Once per Long Rest.
• As an action in combat, make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against a creature you've seen fight (DC 10 + its Challenge Rating). On a success, learn one useful fact of your choice: a damage Resistance/Immunity, a Condition Immunity, a special ability that deals or prevents damage, an option under its Attack/Legendary/Reaction actions, or a special sense.

feats.name: Heavy Glider
feats.description:
Origin feat · Prerequisite: Glide trait
You glide under conditions most can't:
• You may glide while holding a Heavy weapon and wearing Heavy armor, as long as you aren't Encumbered.
• You may land your glide in a space occupied by a hostile Large or smaller creature. Make an opposed Strength check; on a success you push it 10 feet away and knock it Prone, otherwise you land in the nearest unoccupied space.

feats.name: Opportunistic Thief
feats.description:
Origin feat
You exploit openings to steal:
• When a creature misses you with a Melee Attack Roll, you can make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check (DC 10 + the target's Dexterity modifier). On a success, steal one item not held or worn by the target.
• When you successfully use Sleight of Hand out of combat to steal an object, you may immediately conceal it flawlessly or leave another object of yours in its place.

feats.name: Perfect Landing
feats.description:
Origin feat
You fall gracefully:
• Reduce the damage die for fall damage from a d6 to a d4.
• You don't fall Prone after taking falling damage.
• You take no damage for the first 30 feet of a fall.

feats.name: Speech of the Ancient Beasts
feats.description:
Origin feat
Great beasts regard you as kin:
• Beasts of Large size or larger are friendly toward you unless you've attacked them.
• You have Advantage on Charisma checks made against Beasts of Large size or larger.
• You can speak and understand Giant Eagle, Giant Elk, and Giant Owl, and can otherwise be understood by any Beast of Large size or larger. Beasts of Intelligence 4 or lower understand only simple concepts.

feats.name: Woodwise
feats.description:
Origin feat
You navigate the wilds with ease:
• You gain proficiency in either the Survival or Nature skill (your choice).
• You ignore Difficult Terrain.
• You can't become lost in natural surroundings except by magical means.

feats.name: Arboreal Acrobat
feats.description:
You are more at home in the trees than on the ground, granting you the following benefits:
• Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• You gain proficiency in the Acrobatics skill if you don't already have it.
• You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.
• You can use a bonus action to Dash while climbing.
• You can move up to your walking speed between treetops, even if the distance between the trees exceeds your jumping distance, as you swing from branch to branch.

feats.name: Moonlit
feats.description:
You have been blessed by the Amaranthine Eresutha, the Moon's Companion. Her subtle mysteries give you the following benefits:
• Increase your Dexterity, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. (Apply this increase by hand.)
• While you are in dim light, your movements do not provoke opportunity attacks.
• You learn the minor illusion cantrip. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.
• You gain proficiency in one set of artisan's tools of your choice.
• Choose one set of artisan's tools that you are proficient with. You gain expertise with these tools, adding double your proficiency bonus to checks made with them.
(Note: the two artisan's-tools benefits sit ambiguously between Moonlit and the next feat in the two-column playtest layout — verify against the original and move them if they belong elsewhere.)

feats.name: Sun Touched
feats.description:
Your studies with weapons have granted you a blessing from the Amaranthine Khaluz, Guardian of the Sun. You gain the following benefits:
• Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. (Apply this increase by hand.)
• You gain expertise in the Intimidation skill, adding double your proficiency bonus to Intimidation checks.
• When you score a critical hit with a weapon attack, your attack deals 1d10 radiant damage in addition to the extra damage the target takes from the critical hit.
